status: frozen before any vault file was read; vault runs must not change this file or the hashed code

excluded.NEO: no draft parquet (raw CSV only), no game_time
excluded.ONE: no draft parquet (raw CSV only), no game_time

notes: ECL was used for play/draw outcome statistics in the matchmaking memo (not model selection)
MOM has no game_time column (nothing here uses it; day blocks use draft_time)
no-aff sets are pooled separately from ECL/TLA and in 'all'

split: decks.deckstrength.load_drafts: drafts sorted by draft_time, 70% train / 15% val / 15% test

deck strength pipeline (champion v2).model: DeckFM fm4 nonland: card power w (all cards) + rank-4 factorised pairs between nonland cards + 17 standardised Scryfall deck features + the PickNet pool_d32 affinity profile column (deck_synergy_v3.Profile 'aff mean'); --no-aff sets: no affinity column
deck strength pipeline (champion v2).context (game only, not in the deck scor: play/draw, mulligan difference (own - opp), raw user_game_win_rate_bucket + known flag, per-game rank one-hot, experience one-hot (500/1000 fix), record before the game (21 one-hot); opponent rank dropped
deck strength pipeline (champion v2).refit: train+val games, the champion's val-chosen setting, its early-stopping schedule replayed epoch for epoch (game_fm_v2.fit_fm replay), per seed
deck strength pipeline (champion v2).calibration of the refit: the train-only twin's val (a, b) in raw score units, seed-paired
deck strength pipeline (champion v2).deck score: deck-only logit of the most-played build: card power + pairs + deck-feature/affinity terms

record pipeline (round 10).LightGBM features: most-played build's card counts + structure features + own rank + deck features (+ affinity)
record pipeline (round 10).round 4 blend: LightGBM (LGB_PARAMS, early stop on val) logit-blended with the train-calibrated game FM; alpha in 0..1 step 0.05 on val record NLL
record pipeline (round 10).round 10: tau 2 recency weights, default LGB_PARAMS (no improve_v2.json on vault sets), refit on train+val with trees scaled by data size, 5 seeds averaged in logit space, blended with the train+val-calibrated game FM, alpha from the train-only twin on val record NLL
record pipeline (round 10).game FM input: the champion (train-only, seed 0); training drafts cross-fitted on two halves (deck_synergy_v4's fold rule: rng(2) permutation of the training draft ids), val/test drafts scored by the fit on all training games (deck_synergy_v4 draft_inputs)
record pipeline (round 10).targets: draft-file record (primary) and game-file record; evaluated at the player's own rank

metrics.primary: SC-GLL experienced (user_n_games_bucket >= 50), de-leaked-bucket context ('experienced dl'), -1000 x test game log loss, (a, b) on val games, paired day-block bootstrap (500) over test drafts with the seed spread as a variance component
metrics.record metric: test Spearman(p, W/(W+L)), paired day-block bootstrap (300)

H3.claim: refit on train+val (champion v2) - train-only champion > 0 (twin calibration)
H3.special rule: underpowered at k = 6 (MDE ~0.06): confirmed if the vault mean > 0 AND the dev + vault pooled one-sided p < 0.05

H4.claim: round 10 record recipe - round 4 blend > 0 (test Spearman; train draft | eval draft primary)
H4.pair: round 10 - round 4 | train draft | eval draft
H4.secondary: round 10 - round 4 | train game | eval game

dev.pair: round 10 - round 4 | train draft | eval draft

decision rule.per hypothesis: random-effects (DL + HKSJ) mean over the vault sets; one-sided p = P(t_{k-1} > mean / se); CONFIRMED if mean > 0 and one-sided p < 0.05 (H3: mean > 0 and pooled dev + vault one-sided p < 0.05); 'DEV-TEST ONLY' if the vault 95% CI includes 0 and the mean <= 0; otherwise NOT CONFIRMED. eval_protocol.decide (min_positive = ceil(2k/3), min_effect 0) is reported alongside.
